caption:
3 ways to keep AI video consistent in 2026 🎬

1️⃣ Lock it with references: one character sheet attached to every shot (Seedance, Kling Elements, Flow)
2️⃣ Block it in 3D: a grey Blender blockout sets camera and timing, AI renders the look
3️⃣ Act it out: film the performance yourself, transfer motion, face and lip sync to the character (Kling Motion Control, Runway Act-Two)

Which one do you use, or do you mix them? Tell us below 👇

Images: Dreamina, fal, Kling
